definitions.explanation: A destructive fire; a fire that causes damage to buildings or property.

examples.japanese: {火災|かさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{火災|かさい}⟦{報知器|ほうちき}→報知器：27942_houchiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
{火災|かさい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っています→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
{火災|かさい} means fire or fire disaster, typically referring to destructive fires.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {火災|かさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧する (a fire breaks out)
- {火災|かさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (a fire occurs)
- {火災|かさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent fires)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {火災|かさい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (fire insurance)
- {火災|かさい}⟦{報知器|ほうちき}→報知器：27942_houchiki⟧ (fire alarm)
- {火災|かさい}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ (fire alert)
- {火災|かさい}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧ (fire scene)

DIFFERENCE FROM ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧:
- ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧: more casual, everyday word for fire
- {火災|かさい}: more formal, often used in official/news contexts

RELATED:
- ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}→消防：03241_shoubou⟧ (fire fighting)
- ⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧ (fire extinguishing)
